title: 第五章 与生俱来的空间第六章 冤家路宰
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: “仙女姐姐你的手被雷劈了吗？
对不起，我不是故意抓疼你的。”
玄稷只以为范沐禾手上是被雷劈的，这会还在滋滋冒烟呢，赶忙道歉。
看着就疼。
范沐禾：……
玄稷为了表示自己的诚意，把之前被举高高时掉了的那穗狗尾巴草捡起来，塞给范沐禾。
“现在没有鸡蛋，姐姐你先吃这个吧，也很好吃的。”
“这个真的给我？”
范沐禾本想说什么的，想到这小娃可能都不知道，她自己种出来的是何等逆天灵植。
玄稷猛点头直接把狗尾巴草塞范沐禾手上，眼睛笑成月牙真诚道：“嗯！给你吃！”
范沐禾毫不客气接过，心情很好边走边吃。
果实入腹自动转化精纯魔气，滋养丹田经脉，她舒坦的眯起眼。
到跟前本想直接把那片狗尾巴草全都收了的。
见那小娃看着自己紧张的模样，她改变主意了。
当着玄稷的面儿，一株一株慢慢吃给她看。
玄稷是真肉疼了。
这仙女姐姐看着又不胖，却比她和大胖加起来还能吃，已经吃了第三株了。
“仙女姐姐，你还没吃饱吗？”
范沐禾看着小娃儿肉疼的样子，心情极好笑着点头。
“是啊，我饿了很久，这一片都吃完就差不多饱了。”
实际上，这第三株还没吃完，她已经觉得够了。
吃再多，转化的魔气一时半会儿也炼化不了，还得压缩了慢慢炼化。
范沐禾更想把所有的狗尾巴灵草都占为己有了。
有了这些，她修为再进一大阶根本没问题。
看向一旁盯着她的小娃。
有这小娃在，让她一直给自己种灵植，修为重回巅峰根本就不是难题！
但这小娃那么奇怪，不可能是寻常人家的孩子。
“你叫什么名字？”
“你爹娘呢，怎么让你一个人在这？”
“家在哪啊，我先送你回家吧。”
先摸清底细，才好仔细打算。
这非人非兽的小怪物，肯定有家人吧，要是她一个人的血溶不开那飞升通道，加上她家人的一起更有保障。
同时不着痕迹地把奶娃手上她划出来的小伤口，给治好才放心。
玄稷小脸立即垮了，声音闷闷道：“我没有家了，他们都不要我……”
范沐禾虽然没有看见小娃的脸，也能感觉到小娃此刻浑身都所绕在悲伤的气息里。
就连那只狗也蔫巴了不少，还不停地舔着小娃安慰。
范沐禾反应过来，这瘦小的奶娃加上那条骨瘦如柴的狗，大半夜出现在乱葬岗，到现在也没人找，再结合昨晚那邪修，反应过来。
这小娃应该是被家里人献祭给邪修了。
content_en:
"Sister Fairy, was your hand struck by lightning?
Sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you. "
Xuan Ji only thought that Fan Muhe's hand was struck by lightning, and it was still smoking, so he quickly apologized.
It hurts to look at it.
Fan Muhe:......
In order to show his sincerity, Xuan Ji picked up the spike of dogtail grass that had fallen off when he was lifted up, and gave it to Fan Muhe.
"There are no eggs now. Sister, you can eat this first. It's also delicious."
"Is this really for me?"
Fan Muhe was about to say something, but then he thought that this kid might not even know what kind of magical plant she had grown.
Xuan Ji nodded fiercely and stuffed the dog tail grass into Fan Muhe's hand. His eyes turned into crescent moons and he said sincerely, "Yeah! Here you go!"
Fan Muhe took it without politeness and was in a good mood as he walked and ate.
When the fruit entered her abdomen, it automatically transformed into pure demonic energy and nourished her Dantian meridians. She narrowed her eyes in comfort.
When I got there, I wanted to just collect all the dogtail grass.
Seeing the nervous look on the little kid's face, she changed her mind.
In front of Xuan Ji, he slowly ate them one by one for her to see.
Xuanji was really hurting.
This fairy sister doesn't look fat, but she can eat more than she and Big Fat put together. She has already eaten the third one.
"Sister Fairy, aren't you full yet?"
Fan Muhe looked at the little baby's painful appearance and nodded with a smile in a very good mood.
"Yeah, I've been hungry for a long time. I'm almost full after eating this piece."
In fact, before she finished the third one, she already felt it was enough.
No matter how much you eat, the transformed demonic energy won't be refined for a while, and it has to be compressed and refined slowly.
Fan Muhe even wanted to keep all the dog tail spiritual grass for himself.
With these, it would be no problem for her to advance to a higher level of cultivation.
She looked at the little kid staring at her.
With this little kid here, it won't be a problem for her to keep planting spiritual plants for him, and his cultivation will return to its peak!
But this little baby is so strange that he cannot be an ordinary child.
"What's your name?"
"Where are your parents? Why are you here alone?"
"Where is home? Let me take you home first."
Find out the details first before planning carefully.
This little monster, neither human nor beast, must have a family. If her blood alone cannot dissolve the ascension passage, her family will be more secure.
At the same time, she healed the small wound on Milkman's hand without leaving any trace.
Xuan Ji's little face immediately collapsed, and he said in a muffled voice: "I have no home, they don't want me..."
Although Fan Muhe didn't see Xiaowa's face, he could still feel the sadness surrounding Xiaowa's body at this moment.
Even the dog languished a lot and kept licking the baby to comfort him.
Fan Muhe realized that this skinny milk baby and the scrawny dog ​​appeared in the mass grave in the middle of the night, and no one has found them yet. Combined with the evil cultivator last night, he realized it.
This little baby must have been sacrificed to evil cultivators by his family.
